module: Diagnostic tool: on load, it walks the game's whole virtual file system (root '/') looking for *.jbeam, *.pc and *.json files, then decodes them one by one with the jsonDebug library. Syntax errors and warnings are written to the log. Useful to a modder to find an invalid JSON or jbeam.
usage:
extensions.load('util/testJSONFilesSyntax')
-- then read the E/W 'jsonDecode' lines in the log
notes: Everything happens in onExtensionLoaded, synchronously: the game may freeze for a while, because all the game and mod files are read.
The decoding result is not kept; only the logs matter.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called on extension load. Recursively lists the .jbeam, .pc and .json files, reads them with readFile and decodes them with jsonDebug.decode under xpcall; logs errors (E) and warnings (W) under the tag 'jsonDecode'.
